info.name: JalaOps AI-tilannekatsaus
info.description:
Requests for the AI status overview (AI-tilannekatsaus) and its origin check.

**Local (default):** `baseUrl` = `http://localhost:8000`, `origin` = `http://localhost:5173`. With `APP_ENV=local` the origin check is off, so the two "rejected" requests answer 200 and their tests are skipped. The backend's `.env` needs `AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED=true` and the provider's key, otherwise the overview is `{"enabled": false}`.

**Production:** set both `baseUrl` and `origin` to `https://jalaops-demo.jussialanen.com` under the collection's Variables. Use the Postman desktop app: the web version can't set the `Origin` header. Every refresh is an AI call from the app's shared hourly limit (`AI_INSIGHTS_MAX_PER_HOUR`), so refresh sparingly.

**Rate limit:** run "Refresh overview" four times within a minute (Runner, 4 iterations): the fourth answers 429.

console.log('The AI overview is off: set AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED=true and the provider key.');

request.description: Checks that the API and its database answer.
Returns the cached overview right away; calls the AI only when there is none yet. `outdated: true` means the requests have changed since it was written: send "Refresh overview" to update it.

Generates a new overview (an AI call). An overview generated for the same requests within the last minute is returned instead. Limited to three calls per minute per visitor (429 after that). `stale: true` means the hourly AI limit is used up and the previous overview was returned.

exec: console.log('Rate limited: wait a minute, or the hourly AI limit is used up.');

request.description: A request from another website's page is refused with 403, without calling the AI. Allowed everywhere when the backend runs with APP_ENV=local.

exec: pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Tätä toimintoa voi käyttää vain JalaOpsin omalla sivustolla.');

request.description: A request that doesn't come from a web page (no Origin or Referer header), such as a plain script, is refused with 403. Allowed everywhere when the backend runs with APP_ENV=local.

exec: (local ? pm.test.skip : pm.test)('a request without a page gets 403', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
